name: later-gator
description: Private, single-user AI bookmark manager on Cloudflare

scripts.check: npm run build:web && npm run types:check && npm run typecheck:web && npm run check:function-docs && npm run lint && npm run test && npm run test:web

DB.description: Stores the authoritative Later Gator bookmark library and application state.

THUMBNAILS.description: Stores private optimized bookmark preview bytes outside the D1 database.

OAUTH_KV.description: Stores hashed and encrypted AI-connection grants. Cloudflare creates or binds this private namespace during deployment; the owner enters no value.

IMAGES.description: Creates uncropped, aspect-preserving WebP bookmark previews before private Workers KV storage.

AI.description: Runs organization inference when Cloudflare Workers AI is selected.

VECTORS.description: Stores bookmark embeddings so search matches meaning, not just words. Cloudflare cannot pre-fill these two fields, so enter them exactly: **Dimensions** `1024` and **Metric** `cosine`. They must match the `@cf/baai/bge-large-en-v1.5` embedding model and cannot be changed after the index is created.

BACKGROUND_QUEUE.description: Carries opaque AI, embedding, and maintenance job IDs with sequential AI processing.

THUMBNAIL_QUEUE.description: Carries opaque thumbnail job IDs independently of AI processing, with bounded concurrency.

PASSWORD.description: Your Later Gator password — you will type this to sign in. Use 16 or more characters when possible; this field is intentionally blank by default so every installation chooses its own.
